about: Phase 2 LoRA training configuration, frozen at S3 before the phase-1 test run (docs/phase2-plan.md §4, §7; docs/proposed-method.md §9, decisions 18, 19, 23). The training notebook (S5) reads it; changing it after S3 must be recorded as 'after seeing the phase-1 test'.

1.5b.revision: pinned at S5 and recorded in the run output

3b.revision: pinned at S5 and recorded in the run output

export: PEFT adapter of each checkpoint, converted on Kaggle to a GGUF f16 adapter with convert_lora_to_gguf.py of llama.cpp b12032
checkpoint_selection: higher dev EX of the two checkpoints; a tie goes to epoch 2 (decision 23)
stop_rule: at most 2 full trainings per model; the second only fixes a proven pipeline or data bug, no hyper-parameter tuning on dev (decision 23)
library: TRL + PEFT, versions pinned at S5
hardware: Kaggle GPU T4 16 GB, one GPU (DDP over 2 x T4 only if time runs short)
